about_the_game:
玩家交流QQ：300723397

Game Introduction

It is said that when the bell of molten gold rings across the sky, the world beyond will take the place of this shore.

The clock’s marks sum up life’s course.

Moving its hands changes fate.

The girl prays to the gods:“May happy days never fade. May the destined bloom never wither.”

Game Features

This is a tearful short story-based cute girl game.

The entire text is expected to be over 150,000 words. HappyEnd.

Full Live2d, multiple sets of exquisite CG, and full process dubbing.

Character Introduction

  • Han Dong (the male protagonist)

    Students who excel in various aspects, enjoy learning and exercising. Likes Xu Jin. Skilled in the art of language. The ideal is to become a doctor and wants to explore the limits of human lifespan.

    Birthday: December 17th Height: 178CM Affiliated Organization: A key high school in Shanghai

    Favorite thing: Spending time with Xu Jin. Disliked thing: Wasting time.

  • Xu Jin (CV: 可可味)

    The love interest of the male protagonist has become a married couple with each other before even expressing their love. He likes Han Dong. He is good at singing and gardening. His ideal is to become a teacher. He can't cook but is very good at taking care of others.

    Birthday: March 20th Height: 162CM Affiliated Organization: A key high school in Shanghai

    Favorite thing: Delphiniums Disliked thing: Doing homework

  • Xiaojin (Voice: 可可味)

    She was born when the bell rang, and she vanished when the dusk met the demon. Follow that song and win that game of hide-and-seek.

    Birthday: Unknown Height: 140CM Organization: Unknown

    Favorite thing: Sweet food Disliked thing: Withering and falling

Special Declaration

This work is not a stereotypically cute or infantile type of content.

2. This work does not contain any form of dark or disturbing elements.

3. This work features a fantasy setting and is of the romance genre.
